name: stbimage
description: A single compiled instantiation of stb_image and stb_image_write, shared by Ghoul and SGCT so that linking both into the same program does not produce a duplicate-symbol/ODR conflict. See this repository's README for details.

This port lives inside the stbimage repository and builds the enclosing checkout (see portfile.cmake). Ghoul, SGCT, and the OpenSpace superproject each consume it as a git submodule at ext/stbimage, registering ext/stbimage/support/vcpkg/ports as an overlay-port path.
